subject: Fraud & Scams
title: SIM Swapping
description: Learn SIM Swapping in one minute.

hook.text: A thief calls your phone carrier, claims to be you, and transfers your number to their SIM card.

buildup.text: With your phone number, they receive your two-factor authentication codes.

discovery.text: They can now reset passwords for your email, banking, and crypto accounts in minutes.

twist.text: Your phone goes dead. By the time you reach a store, they've already drained your accounts.

climax.text: SIM swapping has stolen hundreds of millions from cryptocurrency holders alone.

punchline.text: Your phone number is a key — and someone else can copy it.

quiz.question: What does a SIM swap attack allow a thief to intercept?
